upgradeCheckout.secureNote: You’ll enter your card on Polar’s secure page. Renews {{date}} until you cancel.
upgradeFailed.title: Your payment didn’t go through
upgradeFailed.lead: Nothing was charged, and {{workspace}} is still on the Free plan. Your choices are kept, so you can try again straight away.
upgradeFailed.pending: Seeing a pending charge? Banks sometimes hold an amount for a few days after a failed payment; it is released without being taken. Still stuck? {{link}} with the reference above.
upgradeFailed.declined.title: Your bank declined the payment
upgradeFailed.declined.detail: The card issuer refused the charge without giving a reason. Cards that block online or international payments often do this.
upgradeFailed.declined.step1: Check your banking app for a payment to approve, then try again.
upgradeFailed.declined.step3: Ask your bank to allow online payments to Polar, our payment provider.
upgradeFailed.insufficientFunds.title: There wasn’t enough on the card
upgradeFailed.insufficientFunds.detail: The bank reported insufficient funds or credit for this amount.
upgradeFailed.insufficientFunds.step2: Switch to monthly billing to pay a smaller amount today.
upgradeFailed.insufficientFunds.step3: Try again once the balance or limit allows it.
upgradeFailed.authentication.title: The bank couldn’t confirm it was you
upgradeFailed.authentication.detail: Your bank asked for a security check (3-D Secure, a code or an app approval) and it wasn’t completed or didn’t match.
upgradeFailed.authentication.step1: Try again and finish the check your bank shows, without closing the window.
upgradeFailed.authentication.step2: Make sure your banking app or phone can receive the code.
upgradeFailed.expiredCard.title: The card has expired
upgradeFailed.expiredCard.detail: The expiry date on the card has passed, or the date entered was wrong.
upgradeFailed.expiredCard.step1: Check the expiry date and try again.
upgradeFailed.processing.title: The payment couldn’t be processed
upgradeFailed.processing.detail: Something went wrong between Polar and the card network. This is usually brief and not caused by your card.
upgradeFailed.processing.step1: Wait a minute and try again.
upgradeFailed.processing.step2: If it happens again, contact us with the reference below.
upgradeFailed.notOpened.title: The payment page didn’t open
upgradeFailed.notOpened.detail: We couldn’t start a checkout with Polar, so you never reached the card form.
upgradeFailed.notOpened.step2: Check your connection, and turn off blockers that stop pop-ups or redirects.
upgradeFailed.notOpened.step3: If it keeps happening, contact us with the reference below.
upgradeDone.waitingLead: Polar has your payment. The plan switches on as soon as they confirm it, usually within a few seconds. You can leave this page; it happens either way.
upgradeDone.slowLead: Polar hasn’t confirmed it yet. The plan switches on by itself when it does. If it hasn’t within 24 hours, email {{email}}.
upgradeDone.missing: This link doesn’t name a payment.
upgradeDone.ticketLead: {{workspace}} now has everything in {{plan}}. Polar has emailed your receipt.
upgradeDone.ticketLeadShort: Your workspace now has everything in {{plan}}. Polar has emailed your receipt.
billing.cardHint: Polar, our payment provider, charges this card when the plan renews.

manage.planFirstNoDate: {{name}} is on {{plan}}. Cancel the plan in Settings → Billing, then delete the workspace. Cancelling stops the next charge.
manage.planEndsWith: Its cancelled {{plan}} plan ends with it, and the rest of the paid period isn’t refunded.

deleteAccount.planEnds: {{name}} is on {{plan}}. It stops renewing now and ends on {{date}}. If you restore your account before then, you can resubscribe in Settings → Billing.
